property_summary: After any number of calls to newGrantProposal, proposalCount always equals the number of proposals created (accessible via mapPID_type entries); the bug increments by 2 instead of 1, causing proposalCount to be strictly greater than the count of non-empty mapPID_type slots when at least one call is made.
change_summary: Change proposalCount += 1 to proposalCount += 2, so proposalCount advances by two instead of one.
